name: Monid
description: Lets agents discover, inspect and pay per call for thousands of third-party tools and data APIs from one balance, over a hosted MCP server, a CLI, an agent skill or an HTTP API.

skills.name: Discover Tools
skills.description: Finds the endpoints and tools in Monid's catalog that fit a task, with monid discover or POST /v1/discover.

skills.name: Inspect Tools
skills.description: Shows a tool's input schema, per-call pricing and documentation before the agent runs it.

skills.name: Run Paid Tools
skills.description: Runs a tool with structured input and returns its results, charged per call to one prepaid Monid balance.
